## Summary

GATE-G8's scoped authorization permits admission-dossier preparation only.
This ticket fills its owner-bound slots in the common seven-row §9.3
amendment register (`docs/build/planning/2026-10-30_amendment-dossier.md`):
the **four method/detector rows** — Packet D (PADR-R5-4∗, finite-task
efficacy), Packet E (PADR-R5-5∗, statistical parity grouping), Packet F
(PADR-R5-6∗, finite-manifest equivalence), Packet G (PADR-R5-7∗,
detectors/analysis metadata) — preceded by one **Shared method contract**
carrying the cross-row items: the shared population/metadata contract, an
additive integer-canonical (ppm/`Json::Int`) numerical representation,
frozen error/tolerance/doubling rules, exact simulation generator
parameters/seeds, routing review and approval scope, and preserved S11
confidence labels. Nothing is admitted: no ADR number is allocated, no
product source/schema/generated file is touched, every proposed name is
marked `∗` unadmitted. GATE-G9 (seq 174) decides.

## Design decisions

- **One spine, no redefinition:** the shared contract (S.1–S.6) homes the
  population/metadata contract, integer-canonical representation, frozen
  tolerances/doubling, the simulation grid + seed-derivation rule, routing
  review/approval scope and S11 labels once; each packet cites it instead
  of re-declaring it.
- **Finite-manifest, never population:** Packet D admits the independent
  per-cell `Beta(1,1)` posterior contrast `Δ^(b) = Σ_t w_t[p_Bt^(b) −
  p_At^(b)]` (w_t = 1/T) as labelled `credible{Beta(1,1),
  finite-manifest}` inference — explicitly not pooled Beta, hierarchical,
  correlated-replicate or TOST; the observed equal-task contrast rides
  beside; 8,000 draws with the frozen 64,000-draw doubling check (the
  hardcoded `BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES = 4_000` at `stats.rs:239` is named as
  the gap, not reused).
- **Grouping without coupling:** Packet E preassigns H/O first attempts
  within `(task, repeat, pair_id)`; across-pair independence is a
  recorded, justified design assumption — no CRN/honoured-seed/R2/causal
  claim; CF-095's honoured-seed pairing path is untouched.
- **Concentration, not CP:** Packet F carries `K_η` directional KL
  bounds, strict TOST (`η=.025` per direction; separate 95% reporting
  interval at `η=.0125`), the completion envelope at preserved N, the
  bounded absolute and relative-mean forms, and the single preregistered
  IUT conjunction — per-null-branch size ≤ α, outward-rounded integer
  endpoints; REQ-D-108 stays a superseded inspected diagnostic.
- **Exact detector windows:** Packet G fixes `(completion_seq(c),
  subject_execution_stop_seq]` joins incl. later compactions, retained
  `(c,event,item)`/`(c,effect)` joins, unbounded intensity (no ppm
  clamp), before-collection versioned declarations, and complete frozen
  families incl. unavailable members.
